context: A boss and manager review a CSR/news topic
purpose: Teach: 文化財/水面/悪質/脅迫/製薬/地価/告げる/変容

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 記事に、わが社の地価評価が変容したと告げる文があった。
lines.en: The article mentioned that our company's land valuation has changed.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate opening. Tone drops slightly on the valuation concern. Pause before the final clause — choosing words carefully, not alarmed but registering weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製薬部門の用地、文化財との隣接で注目です。
lines.en: Yes. The pharma division's property is drawing attention because of its proximity to the cultural heritage site.
lines.style: Quiet, competent delivery. Direct factual tone, no embellishment. Steady eye contact — reporting what's known. Slight lift at the end, inviting his next thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 水面下で、悪質な仲介業者が動いているとも。
lines.en: And there are reports of unscrupulous brokers moving behind the scenes.
lines.style: Lower register, more deliberate. Weight on 'unscrupulous.' Slight lean forward — this is the harder part. Not alarmed, but grave. Controlled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 脅迫まがいの問い合わせ、社内でも記録しています。
lines.en: We've already been logging inquiries internally that border on coercive.
lines.style: Steady, almost clinical precision. Professional distance maintained. Slight emphasis on 'logging' — documenting, protecting. No defensiveness, just fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 警察と速やかに連携を。
lines.style: Quiet authority. Each word lands. No room for interpretation. Not loud — the firmness comes from absolute clarity and conviction.
